visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a white cap and black graphic t-shirt stands in an outdoor patio area with a stone wall background. He holds a white baseball in his right hand and a teal-green baseball bat in his left, with another bat secured between his legs. (2) He begins an instructional demonstration, tapping the baseball against the teal bat barrel repeatedly while looking at the camera with a focused expression. Sunlight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the stone-paved floor and nearby green plants. (3) The man continues the tapping motion, moving the ball along the bat to demonstrate resonance. He uses hand gestures to emphasize points, holding both bats up to show their design and colors. (4) In the final phase, he holds both baseball bats (one teal/green, one orange/blue) clearly in front of him, looking directly at the camera to deliver a promotional message about the bats' availability.

These incidental noise events have varying acoustic resonance as the speaker physically moves along the bat barrel. (3) The speaker's delivery remains clear and enunciated.
